plan: This looks like the classical hand shape where the index finger is fully extended upwards and the thumb is extended horizontally to the right, while the middle, ring and little fingers are curled into the palm (their tips touching or near the base of the index). Palm faces the front camera. Plan: - Index: mcp ~ 0 (straight), pip ~ 0, dip ~ 0 (fully extended). - Middle, Ring, Little: mcp ~ 80–95 (flexed), pip ~ 90–110 (deep flexion), dip ~ 60–80 (curled). - Thumb: thumb_cmc_abd positive (spread outward) ~ 20–30 to point thumb to the right; thumb_cmc_flex ~ 0–10 (not sweeping across palm); thumb_mcp ~ 0–10, thumb_ip ~ 0–10 (nearly straight). - Finger abduction (F_abd): index slightly toward thumb (maybe +5), middle/ ring neutral or slightly inward, little slightly toward palm (-10 to -5) to match tight curl. - Hand orientation: palm facing camera, fingers vertical; use turn_hand roll small to align, yaw to keep thumb pointing right and index vertical. I will set joints gradually to stay within 45° per-call limits and iterate with looks to refine.

plan:
I believe the target is a classical Indian hasta in which the index and little fingers are fully extended upward, the middle and ring fingers are strongly flexed (curled into the palm), and the thumb is bent across toward the curled fingers, touching or almost touching them to form a small loop. The palm faces the camera with the fingers pointing roughly up and a slight turn so the hand's right (thumb) side is a bit forward.

Desired per-finger placements (starting plan, absolute angles):
- Index: mcp ~ 5–10 (nearly straight), pip ~ 0, dip ~ 0, slight abduction toward thumb (F_abd ~ -5).
- Middle: mcp ~ 80, pip ~ 90, dip ~ 60, F_abd ~ 0 (curled into palm).
- Ring: mcp ~ 80, pip ~ 90, dip ~ 60, F_abd ~ 0.
- Little: mcp ~ 5–10 (nearly straight), pip ~ 0, dip ~ 0, F_abd ~ 12 (spread toward little finger side).
- Thumb: cmc_flex ~ 25 (swept toward the curled fingers), cmc_abd ~ -10 (tucked slightly alongside index), cmc_rot ~ 0, mcp ~ 30, ip ~ 30.

Orientation: small roll to align the palm (roll ~ 0), pitch slight away from camera (pitch ~ -10) so curled fingers sit naturally, yaw slight to tilt fingers toward image left (yaw ~ -10).

I'll set these initial joint angles and orientation, then iteratively refine after looking. I'll begin by setting the finger joints and the hand turn.
